title: Not A Writing Gap (Auth Not Content)
style: diagnostic clarity anthem, 96 bpm, root cause rap, deadpan precision, no ambiguity flow, terminal core, auth not content vibe, ledger discipline
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Not a writing task it's a token wrap
The HTML is done it's just the deploy gap
Sharp swanson sixty five F three B four
Claude code filed the proof on the floor

[Pre-Chorus]
The site is built the deploy is blocked
Same token issue sixteen days clocked

[Chorus]
Not a writing gap not a writing gap
It's a one click upload on the dashboard map
Or a five minute env variable swap
Thirty six sites unlock at the top

[Verse 2]
Scopes available on the VDS proven
Pages edit not among them woven
Account settings read also missing
Two scopes regen ends the kissing

[Bridge]
This is not a content problem this is auth
The ledger cannot mistake the path

[Outro]
Not a writing gap deploy is the pin
One click or one token unblock the win
